# Lightwave: MDU Broadband Focuses on Resident Experience


Sean Buckley of Lightwave Online highlights how MDU broadband is evolving beyond connectivity to deliver a more integrated resident experience. The article notes that providers are combining high-speed broadband with managed Wi-Fi and smart property technologies, while solutions from companies including Calix help operators modernize brownfield properties and provide seamless, always-on experiences for residents and property owners alike.


[Read the full article on Lightwave](https://www.lightwaveonline.com/home/article/55393182/the-new-mdu-broadband-experience)
